title: Vendor Staff
description: A person belonging to a vendor organization (GLOSSARY.md). Org membership and role (owner/manager/staff) are Keto relation tuples, not identity traits (M2) — this schema only carries the profile fields a staff account needs.

name.title: Name
name.description: Displayed to other staff in the Vendor Back-office (M2) and on the Keto/Oathkeeper audit trail.

phone.title: Work phone
phone.description: Optional work contact number (PRIVACY.md) — e.g. for step-up MFA notifications on sensitive vendor operations (CHARTER.md).
